title: Sidebarlayout
description: Two-column layout: a sidebar beside a main area that grows to fill the remaining space.

side.description: Which child is the sidebar: left makes the first child the sidebar, right the second.

sideWidth.description: Width of the sidebar, as any CSS length.

contentMin.description: Narrowest the main area may get before the sidebar wraps underneath it, as a CSS length or percentage.

gap.description: Space between the sidebar and the main area, as any CSS length.

_metadata.derivedFrom: the behavior implementation — every property here is one the code actually reads
_metadata.note: Expand by hand: enums, richer descriptions and accessibility notes cannot be read from source.
